Sport Boys also field Cueva, Alarcon and Urruti behind Erustes. Universitario's recent league run is 2-2, 4-1, 3-0 and 3-1, but Sport Boys' recent away league results are much more suppressive: 1-0 win, 0-2 loss, 1-1 draw and 1-2 loss. match.independent_upper_tail_basis: Universitario's recent upper tail is real, but Sport Boys' recent away 0-1/0-2/1-1/1-2 profile makes the fourth-goal environment too dependent on a home blowout rather than an independently transferable total-match tail.
match.upper_tail_transferability_basis: The home carrier's recent four-plus outputs are current, but the away team's recent road suppression reduces matchup-level transferability above G3.
match.upper_tail_comparable_context_basis: Universitario are strongly expansive in recent league form, while Sport Boys' away matches are predominantly low-to-moderate total; the matchup context is mixed above three goals.
